table sit_done note text?
setting length dur = 10m "Breathe length"
timer length, "Breathe", add sit_done then notify "Breathe done"
count(sit_done today) "today" head
stat streak(sit_done), "day streak"
timer 5m, "Rest"
list sit_done today
after:
app "Meditation" moon mint
table sit_done note text?
setting length dur = 60m "Breathe length"
timer length, "Breathe", add sit_done then notify "Breathe done"
count(sit_done today) "today" head
stat streak(sit_done), "day streak"
timer 5m, "Rest"
list sit_done today
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: start with who it is for
